completed: FIX 1 + 2 SHIPPED in routes/engine.js. `comfy install` now takes `--version <COMFY_VERSION>`; comfy-cli's default is `nightly` (= latest master commit), which WAS the defect. Confirmed from comfy-cli SOURCE, not just its help text: validate_version accepts '0.29.2', checkout_stable_comfyui re-adds the 'v' and checks out the tag, git_checkout_tag fetches tags when absent, and the checkout runs whenever version != nightly INDEPENDENTLY of --restore -- so retries onto an existing workspace also land on the pin. Separately, a new `_readInstalledComfyVersion(engineRoot)` helper reads `__version__` out of the installed tree's comfyui_version.py and that is what gets stamped into .mpi_engine_version; the pin is only a fallback and logs a warning when used. getComfyPath resolves comfyui_version.py correctly on BOTH layouts, so it is one code path for both engines.

FIX 3 + 4 SHIPPED. dev_configs/system_dependencies.json engine.version -> 0.29.2. dev_configs/node_lock.json comfyui.core -> tag v0.29.2 / commit 322122449c9d2ba8b8df1bb517364527dd0615f1, frontend -> comfyui-frontend-package 1.47.11 + comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.20. IMPORTANT: those frontend numbers came from requirements.txt AT THE v0.29.2 TAG. The 0.29.0 changelog understates both (it says 1.47.10 / 0.11.19) -- the previous handoff was right to warn about this. Full requirements delta 0.28.0 -> 0.29.2 is only 4 lines: those two, comfyui-embedded-docs 0.5.8 -> 0.5.9, and comfy-kitchen 0.2.20 -> 0.2.22 (the package the new rope helpers live in). NO torch change.

FIX 5 SHIPPED. ComfyUI-LTXVideo bumped 4f45fd6c -> 3b9c5cde4700917074823d45e25401d81049f8fc. That is upstream PR #532 'Support ComfyUI core rope change' (+20/-3, merged 2026-07-27), which wraps the import in a try/except: new core uses freqs_cis_matrix, legacy core keeps interleaved_freqs_cis. IT IS BACKWARDS COMPATIBLE -- verified in the file -- so the bumped node runs on 0.28 AND 0.29. That is why the Pod can stay at 0.28.0 until it is rebuilt without breaking. Confirmed at source that interleaved_freqs_cis exists in core v0.28.0 (2 occurrences) and is GONE in v0.29.2 (0).

FIX 6 DONE -- the sweep says DO NOT BUMP the other 13. Measured each pinned node's distance from its upstream tip: 9 of 14 are already AT tip (MpiNodes, PainterI2Vadvanced, Impact-Pack, Frame-Interpolation, Impact-Subpack, Krea2-ControlNet, controlnet_aux, inpaint-cropandstitch, and LTX before its bump). The 5 behind (VideoHelperSuite 1, UltimateSDUpscale 1, kjnodes 23, RES4LYF 18, krea2edit 12) are behind for unrelated feature reasons -- NONE has shipped a 0.29 adaptation. LTX was the only node upstream adapted. Moving a pin without a reason is how untested drift enters a release; they were deliberately left alone. Full table in tasks/MPI-419/validation.md.

FIX 7 WAS A NO-OP -- do not go looking for it. routes/platformEngine.js:20 builds COMFY_BASE from COMFY_VERSION, so bumping system_dependencies.json moves the Windows archive download to the v0.29.2 assets automatically. There is no URL or hash to edit. Confirmed all four ComfyUI_windows_portable_*.7z assets exist on the v0.29.2 release (nvidia = 2,103,175,457 bytes).

WINDOWS LEG PASSED (leg 1 of the user's order). The user DE-SCOPED a full engine reinstall here ('mainly to see there aren't failed nodes'). The dev engine's ComfyUI is a real git clone and weights live outside it on G:/CubricModels, so 0.29.2 was tested IN PLACE: `git checkout v0.29.2` in engine/ComfyUI_windows_portable/ComfyUI plus the 4 changed pip packages into python_embeded. That preserved the MpiNodes dev symlink and skipped a 2.1GB download. Live /system_stats reports comfyui_version 0.29.2, pytorch 2.13.0+cu130.
